name: L10 LSAA Vienna source-disjoint unique-building address-door panel V3
question: Does LSAA admit a provider-, city-, and building-disjoint panel with exact raw OSM numeric credentials and official single-door instances, without pixel-selected examples or repeated-building leakage?

providers.dataset: Large Scale Architectural Asset Dataset (LSAA), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

selection.pixel_blind: Selection may read only LSAA CSV/JSON metadata, current OSM way tags, and prior source identities. It may not request or decode a facade, door crop, panorama, thumbnail, OCR output, portal output, or model score.
selection.negative_control: Within each split, rotate the next distinct true house number onto the current facade as a deterministic counterfactual mission. Any emitted binding is wrong for that control.
selection.v1_correction: V1 canonicalized punctuation before admission and therefore admitted address ranges as single tokens; V2 and V3 require the raw stripped OSM field itself to match one to four digits.
selection.v2_correction: V2 admitted repeated buildings and three development-to-confirmation building overlaps. V3 retains only the first stable-ranked facade for each OSM building across the full 48-row panel.

claim_boundary: A source admission pass establishes only a pixel-blind, provider-, city-, and selected-building-disjoint candidate panel. OSM address tags and LSAA door boxes are not visible-text truth, runtime model inputs, portal ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety evidence.
